newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Reading & Bates buy affirmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Reading & Bates buy affirmed.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc on Monday reaffirmed its buy rating on Reading & Bates Corp with a 12-month price target of $40, a 28-percent appreciation from the current share price.

-- Hanifen said one of the company's jackups, the Harvey H. Ward, was struck by a barge and crippled while working offshore of India for Enron Oil & Gas Co. The company said it hired a dry tow vessel to mobilize the damaged rig to a shore base for repair, Hanifen said.
-- It appears the repairs to the Ward's damaged leg may not be completed before the monsoon season begins in May, Hanifen said.
-- Reading & Bates operates a fleet of 19 oil rigs.
-- Its shares were trading down 3/4 Monday at 30-5/8.
